title: Sharing a unit, measuring a length: a didactic analysis of a teaching progression for fractions from Grade 1 to Grade 8
summary: Fractions require learners to revise properties associated with whole numbers. This paper presents a design rationale and a critical analysis of an eight-level source progression for fractions (Grades 1-8, nominal ages 6-14), from which the French-curriculum and International Baccalaureate chapters published at https://commeunjeu.org are assembled. Its central hypothesis is a bridge from sharing to numerical measure: a share of one unit is represented by a bar, read as a length relative to a specified unit, and located on the number line.
